rationales.deterministic-orchestration-v2: forms (a), (b), and (c) — code fixes the three-stage sequence of classification, impact analysis, and action recommendation; dispatches three LLMs as bounded workers at each stage and aggregates their outputs through confidence-weighted voting; and deterministically maps the propagated trust score and severity through threshold rules to approve, warn, require human review, or block deployment. The pipeline was run and evaluated, and no model controls which stage executes next or what an outcome triggers.
